Name: Spirit Bushes
Author: CHA4S3E
Description:
[size=3]On the Day of Spirit's Eve, You will be able to find "Spirit Bushes" in the forest, Shake the Bushes to get the "Spirit Torches", A Light source that emits darkness instead of light.

[/size][color=#ff7700][b]More Details
[/b][/color][color=#b4a7d6]The Spirit Bushes cannot be found in the Farm & Town Regions of the Map.
[/color][color=#ffd966]The Spirit Bushes can only be found on Fall 27 (Spirit's Eve)[/color]


[b][color=#93c47d]Known Bugs[/color]
[/b]The Spirit Torches may have a Quality on them, When placed and break they will reset to Normal, I'm not sure if there is a fix to this..
